lat_definition: LAT[a][b] = sum over x in {0,...,15} of (-1)^(parity(a & x) xor parity(b & S(x)))
allowed_sbox_mask_transition: A nibble-mask pair (a,b) is allowed if and only if LAT[a][b] != 0.
bit_numbering: State-mask positions are numbered 0 through 63 from left to right in every 64-character binary string.
nibble_numbering: Nibble i consists of positions 4*i, 4*i+1, 4*i+2, 4*i+3 in most-significant-bit to least-significant-bit order.
round_definition: Apply 16 parallel S-box mask transitions, then set next_state_mask[P(i)] = sbox_output_mask[i] for every bit position i.
key_addition_scope: Round-key XOR changes the sign of a linear approximation but not whether its correlation is zero, so key addition is omitted from this fixed-mask trail-feasibility model.
